descriptions.w3d_pset_get_class: Returns the ParticleSet class record, which also lists live ParticleSet objects.
descriptions.w3d_pset_unlink: Removes a ParticleSet from its class list and decrements the live count.
descriptions.w3d_pset_create: Allocates and constructs a ParticleSet and registers it in its class list.
descriptions.w3d_pset_interfaces: Returns the ParticleSet interface table used by interface queries.
descriptions.w3d_pset_release: Drops one reference; on the last one unlinks and deletes the ParticleSet. Returns the remaining count.
descriptions.w3d_pset_add_ref: Adds one reference to a ParticleSet and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_pset_query_interface: Looks up a requested interface on a ParticleSet through its interface table.
descriptions.w3d_pset_copy_settings: Copies settings from another looked-up ParticleSet, marks them overridden and takes its emitter reference.
descriptions.w3d_pset_pool_size: Returns the number of slots in the particle-set instance pool.
descriptions.w3d_pset_pool_used: Returns how many particle-set instance pool slots are in use.
descriptions.w3d_pset_check_override: Returns success when the settings-overridden flag is set, otherwise a failure status.
descriptions.w3d_pset_reset: Clears the override flag and releases the group and holder references.
descriptions.w3d_pset_set_flag_0: Switches the effect between two global states and records the choice in flag bit 0.
descriptions.w3d_pset_set_flag_1: Switches the effect between two global states and records the choice in flag bit 1.
descriptions.w3d_pset_set_flag_4: Switches the effect between two global states and records the choice in flag bit 4.
descriptions.w3d_pset_save: Saves the base descriptor, then writes the ParticleSetGroup reference to the archive.
descriptions.w3d_pset_load: Loads the base descriptor, then reads the ParticleSetGroup reference from the archive.
descriptions.w3d_pset_flag_0: Returns flag bit 0 of the ParticleSet.
descriptions.w3d_pset_flag_1: Returns flag bit 1 of the ParticleSet.
descriptions.w3d_pset_flag_4: Returns flag bit 4 of the ParticleSet.
descriptions.w3d_pset_instance_construct: Constructs an XParticleSetInstance, clears its emitter reference and counts live instances.
descriptions.w3d_pset_instance_destruct: Destroys an XParticleSetInstance: releases its emitter, decrements the count and runs the base destructor.
